items.title: 30.3 Chemical environment aur chemical shift (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of chemical environment and chemical shift (PDF 203-206).

blocks.text: Chemical shift kisi signal ki jagah aik hawala compound ke muqable deta hai. Tetramethylsilane, Si(CH3)4 (TMS), standard hawala hai, aur is ke signal ko 0.0 ppm qeemat di jati hai; baqi tamam signals is se nape jate hain. 1H NMR spectrum mein TMS peak ke muqable kisi peak ki jagah chemical shift (delta) hai, jo parts per million (ppm) mein napi jati hai. Chemical shift proton ka electronic environment dikhati hai: mukhtalif environments ke protons ki delta qeematein mukhtalif aur aik environment walon ki barabar hoti hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain? TMS kyun?
blocks.text: TMS ke tamam 12 protons ka environment aik hai, is liye yeh aik tez peak deta hai. Silicon ki electronegativity kam hai, is liye TMS peak spectrum ke bilkul daen hai aur zyada tar organic signals se nahi milti. TMS kimiyai taur par be-asar aur urne wala bhi hai, is liye baad mein aasani se nikal jata hai.

blocks.alt: Tetramethylsilane ki banawat: darmiyan mein silicon atom, chaar CH3 groups se jura, oopar, neeche, baen (H3C) aur daen. Label: Tetramethylsilane (TMS).
blocks.caption: Tetramethylsilane (TMS) (kitab ke Did You Know box ki banawat ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Methanol ke 1H NMR spectrum mein methyl (-CH3) hydrogens 3.35 ppm aur O-H hydrogen 4.80 ppm par aate hain, 0.0 ppm wale TMS se nape gaye.

blocks.alt: Delta paimane (scale) 6 se 0 par 1H NMR spectrum. 4.80 par chhoti peak (neela label), 3.35 par lambi peak (gulabi label), aur 0 par TMS ki peak. Oopar baen methanol ka khula formula: C-H ke teen hydrogens gulabi aur O-H ka hydrogen neela.
blocks.caption: Figure 30.2: Methanol ka 1H NMR spectrum (kitab ki Figure 30.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gulabi rang ke teen CH3 protons 3.35 ppm par lambi peak dete hain, aur neela O-H proton 4.80 ppm par chhoti peak. Peak ki lambai protons ki tadaad dikhati hai (3 aur 1). TMS 0 par hawala (reference) hai.

Molecule ke protons electrons se ghire hote hain, aur yeh electron density NMR spectrum par asar karti hai; molecule ke mukhtalif hisson ke protons qareebi atoms aur bonds ki wajah se mukhtalif 'environments' mein hain. Molecule mein kimiyai taur par aik jaise environments ke tamam protons chemically equivalent hain aur un ki chemical shift aik hai. TMS, methane, ethane, benzene, cyclohexane aur propanone ke tamam protons chemically equivalent hain, is liye har aik compound aik peak deta hai.

blocks.alt: Methane, ethane, benzene aur cyclohexane ke khule formulas. Har molecule ka har hydrogen atom Ha likha hai.
blocks.caption: In molecules ke tamam hydrogen atoms ka chemical environment aik hai (30.3 mein chhapi banawaton ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: PPM paimana 3 se 0, aur taqreeban 0.2 par aik tez peak. Plot ke andar methane ka khula formula aur jumla: The protons are equivalent and give one NMR signal (protons barabar hain aur aik NMR signal dete hain).
blocks.caption: Figure 30.3: Methane ka 1H NMR spectrum (kitab ki Figure 30.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har molecule ke tamam hydrogens Ha hain, yani aik hi environment. Is liye methane ka spectrum sirf aik peak dikhata hai.
Kimiyai taur par mukhtalif protons ke sets wale molecules aik se zyada peaks dete hain: propane aur methanol ke do environments, aur 1-chloropropane aur ethanol ke teen hain.

blocks.alt: Do dabbe. Pehla: propane (kinare ke chhe hydrogens Ha, darmiyani do Hb) aur methanol (C-H ke teen Hb, O-H ka Ha); likha hai: Molecules having two different chemical environments for protons. Doosra: 1-chloropropane (chlorine wale sire se Hc, Hb, Ha) aur ethanol (CH3 ke Hc, CH2 ke Hb, O-H ka Ha); likha hai: Molecules having three different chemical environments for protons.
blocks.caption: Protons ke do aur teen mukhtalif chemical environments wale molecules (30.3 mein chhape dabbon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har harf (a, b, c) aik environment hai. Propane aur methanol mein do harf (a, b), is liye do peaks; 1-chloropropane aur ethanol mein teen (a, b, c), is liye teen peaks.

Proton ki chemical shift us ke gird electron density par munhasir hai. Zyada electron density (alkyl groups) mein ghire protons ki chemical shift kam, jab ke kam electron density mein, F, O, N ya Cl jaise electronegative atoms ke qareeb, protons zyada chemical shift par aate hain. Methanol mein CH3 protons, zyada electron density ke saath, 3.35 ppm par aur O-H proton, electronegative oxygen ke saath, 4.80 ppm par aata hai. 1H NMR spectrum 0-12 ppm tak hai.

blocks.caption: Kuch aam qism ke protons ki chemical shifts (kitab ka Table 30.1)
rows: electronegative atom ke saath alkyl (halogenoalkanes, alcohols)

blocks.prompt: TMS ke 12 protons sirf aik peak kyun dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh sab aik hi kimiyai environment mein hain (har aik usi Si se jure CH3 group mein), is liye chemically equivalent hain.

blocks.prompt: (i) propane, (ii) propan-2-ol, (iii) butan-2-one mein kitne proton environments hain, aur kin shifts par?
blocks.explanation: (i) Propane: 2 (CH3 aur CH2), dono alkyl, 0.5-1.5 ppm. (ii) Propan-2-ol: 3, CH3 0.5-1.5, O ke saath CH 3.0-4.5, OH 0.5-6.0. (iii) Butan-2-one, CH3COCH2CH3: 3, C=O ke saath CH3 2.0-2.6, C=O ke saath CH2 2.0-2.6, ethyl group ka CH3 0.5-1.5.

blocks.prompt: Kitab '1,1,2,2-dichloroethane' ke baare mein bhi poochhti hai. Is ke kitne environments honge?
blocks.explanation: Naam ghalat chhapa hai. 1,2-dichloroethane (ClCH2CH2Cl) aur 1,1,2,2-tetrachloroethane (Cl2CHCHCl2) dono ke tamam protons barabar hain: aik environment, chlorine atoms ki wajah se zyada delta par.

blocks.prompt: delta 7.5 ppm par signal ghaliban kis proton environment ko zahir karta hai?

items: Chemical shift delta (ppm) TMS 0.0 ppm se napi jati.
Barabar protons aik signal; environments gin kar peaks ginein.
